audit.summary: An exact consistency model with a smooth Gaussian target violates Theorem 3. Independently, the general-data proof uses an impossible deterministic marginal transport at an atomic time-zero endpoint.
limitations: P1 — Theorem 3 has a false smoothing-bias scale dependence — Counterevidence: Theorem3 has no bounded-output restriction, L>=1 assumption, or small-noise restriction. Exact consistency and a smooth target exclude approximation and atomic-endpoint explanations. Conditional KL recurrence is not disproved.

P2 — The general-data induction uses an impossible deterministic atomic endpoint coupling — Counterevidence: A backward endpoint map can exist. Pairing a positive-time draw with its backward endpoint or specifying a random entrance law would change the hypothesis. Literal bounded output for all x at t=0 conflicts with global identity in Theorems2/4; no full counterexample to those contradictory literal assumptions is asserted.
